**Generated by** `scripts/generate-capability-surface.mjs` from the Zod schemas the
dispatchers register. **Do not edit.** Regenerate with:

```bash
npm run build && node scripts/generate-capability-surface.mjs
```

This file exists so that **removing an action, dropping an enum, or loosening a
bound shows up as a red line in code review.** The v1.6 consolidation silently
removed a config whitelist, seven enums and every numeric bound, and nothing
caught it. CI regenerates this file and fails if the result differs from what is
committed — so a surface change nobody wrote down blocks the merge.

Deliberately **excludes the package version**, so a version bump alone never
produces a diff. The surface is the contract; the version is not part of it.
